दिवाली के संडे पर बॉक्स ऑफिस पर आया बड़ा तूफान, रणबीर और यश की फिल्म ने उड़ाए होश! 💥

Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बनी फिल्म Ramayana ने अपने चौथे दिन यानी 8 November दिवाली संडे को कमाई के सारे रिकॉर्ड हिला दिए हैं।

फिल्म ने advance booking में ही 10.86 लाख tickets बेचकर 23,077 shows से 34.43 crore gross collection कर लिया है।

Rs 321 की average ticket price के साथ Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru और Ahmedabad जैसे शहरों में शाम की occupancy 75% से ऊपर जाने की उम्मीद है।

रविवार सुबह 34.2% occupancy के साथ फिल्म ने लगभग 17 crore कमा लिए हैं और यह Pathaan के 58.5 crore, Drishyam 3 के 61 crore और Animal के 63.46 crore के संडे रिकॉर्ड को चुनौती दे रही है। 🚀🔥

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana पहले संडे की कमाई में Animal का ऑल-टाइम रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर दें! 👇

ctx.text:
The box office hurricane surrounding director Nitesh Tiwari’s magnum opus Ramayana starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi is reaching unprecedented heights. As the epic multi-language visual spectacle moves into its First Sunday (Day 4, November 8), the advance booking counters have recorded staggering numbers in India!
Driven by good word-of-mouth and extended Diwali holiday footfalls, Ramayana has locked in a monumental 34.43 crore gross collection in advance bookings alone for Day 4 (excluding blocked seats). Over 10.86 lakh tickets have already been booked across 23,077 shows in India, setting up the film for a huge single-day surge!
A massive surge is expected on Sunday, with a current Average Ticket Price of Rs 321 in India. Afternoon and evening show occupancies are pacing toward 75%+ across major metropolitan hubs like Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru, and Ahmedabad.
With already a net collection of 29.20 crore strictly through pre-sales before Sunday walk-ins commenced, Ramayana is positioned to mount a strong challenge against the all-time highest First Sunday collections in Hindi cinema. Meanwhile, on Sunday, November 8, Diwali, day 4, the film has already earned close to 17 crore , with a morning occupancy of 34.2%.
The film is very well positioned to enter the top 5 biggest first Sundays of Bollywood, surpassing Pathaan’s 58.5 crore and even Drishyam 3 ‘s 61 crore ! In all probability, it might also surpass Animal’s first Sunday of 63.46 crore !

Accumulating 10.86 lakh sold tickets and bringing in 34.43 crore gross in pure advance bookings, Ramayana enters Sunday with overwhelming box office power. As family footfalls peak across the extended Diwali weekend, Ranbir Kapoor and Yash are on course to deliver a historic single-day collection!
